import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Top products by total sales (bar chart)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars = ax1.bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Products by Total Sales', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 5,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by age group (pie chart)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 11})
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Sales by size (grouped bar chart)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
size_product_sales = df.groupby(['size', 'product'])['total'].sum().unstack().fillna(0)
size_product_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, width=0.8)
ax3.set_title('Sales by Product Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend(title='Product', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 4. Payment method distribution (horizontal bar chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
bars = ax4.barh(payment_counts.index, payment_counts.values)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Count by Payment Method', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Payment Method', fontsize=12)
for i, (value, bar) in enumerate(zip(payment_counts.values, bars)):
    ax4.text(value + 10, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
             f'{value:,}', va='center', fontsize=11)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in sales (stacked bar chart)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
takeaway_sales = df.groupby(['is_takeaway', 'customer_age_group'])['total'].sum().unstack().fillna(0)
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
bottom = np.zeros(len(takeaway_sales.columns))
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(takeaway_sales.iterrows()):
    ax5.bar(takeaway_sales.columns, row.values, bottom=bottom, label=takeaway_labels[i])
    bottom += row.values
ax5.set_title('Sales: Takeaway vs Dine-in by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
ax5.legend(title='Order Type')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Price distribution by product (box plot)
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
top_products = df['product'].value_counts().head(6).index
top_products_data = df[df['product'].isin(top_products)]
sns.boxplot(data=top_products_data, x='product', y='price', ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Price Distribution of Top Products', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Price ($)', fontsize=12)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
